title: GTA 6 Leaker Drops Nudity Footage and Polls on Spoilers
description: Recent GTA 6 reports from IGN Games reveal new leaked nudity gameplay footage, with the leaker polling fans on releasing story spoilers next.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## New Unverified GTA 6 Footage and Story Spoiler Poll Emerge

The anticipation surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming title, GTA 6, continues to be overshadowed by ongoing leaks and security challenges. According to a recent report by gaming media outlet IGN Games, an extraordinary set of leaks from the past week has escalated today with the release of a significant new set of footage featuring mass nudity.

In addition to the newly surfaced media, the individual behind the leaks has reportedly initiated a poll, asking fans whether they should proceed to post story spoilers next. This tactic has drawn considerable attention across online gaming communities as players weigh the implications of potential major plot disclosures.

## Calls for Protests Outside Developer Offices

The situation has taken an unusual turn beyond digital leaks. Reports indicate that the leaker has also called on fans to stage protests outside the physical offices of Rockstar Games and Take-Two Interactive. At this time, neither Rockstar Games nor Take-Two Interactive has issued any official statement regarding the leaked materials or the ongoing community disruptions.

As these developments stem from unverified channels, players and community members are advised to treat the footage and upcoming claims with caution, especially regarding potential story spoilers circulating online.

## Editor's Take

As GTA6 Hub editors, we strongly advise the community to stay vigilant against potential spoilers. Unverified leaks can ruin the eventual gaming experience, and it is always best to rely strictly on official updates from Rockstar Games.
